reason: RM 2.80 a pouch is 80 sen more than the Whiskas I already throw in the trolley, and my cat goes through a lot of pouches in a month. I'd follow the page to get the free pack, but I wouldn't pay for a brand I've never heard of on top of that.
objection: My cat is fussy. If I pay more for a new brand and she sniffs it and walks away, that money is just gone, and I don't have spare money for experiments.
would_change_my_mind: If she finishes the free pack and the pouches were about RM 2 each, same as Whiskas, or there was a bundle deal that worked out to that, and I could pick it up at the supermarket or on Shopee instead of having to message a page.
